_about: Names whose best-known bearer is remembered for evil (design 3.4). One plain sentence each, shown at the top of the page. Information, not a ruling on the name.

cautions.Jezebel: In the Bible, Jezebel is remembered as the queen who promoted Baal worship and had Naboth killed.
cautions.Cain: In the Bible, Cain is remembered as the first murderer, who killed his brother Abel.
cautions.Delilah: In the Bible, Delilah is remembered for betraying Samson to the Philistines for money.
cautions.Judas: In the Bible, the best-known Judas is Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus; another apostle and a brother of Jesus also bore the name.
cautions.Herod: In the Bible, Herod is remembered as the king who ordered the killing of the boys of Bethlehem; later Herods killed John the Baptist and James.
cautions.Haman: In the Bible, Haman is remembered as the official who plotted to destroy the Jewish people.
cautions.Ahab: In the Bible, Ahab is remembered as the king of Israel who did more evil than all before him and served Baal.
cautions.Athaliah: In the Bible, Athaliah is remembered as the queen who killed the royal family of Judah to seize the throne.
cautions.Nimrod: In the Bible, Nimrod is remembered as a mighty hunter and the founder of Babel and Nineveh.
cautions.Jeroboam: In the Bible, Jeroboam is remembered as the king who set up golden calves and made Israel sin.
cautions.Absalom: In the Bible, Absalom is remembered as David's son who rebelled against his father.
cautions.Esau: In the Bible, Esau is remembered for selling his birthright to his brother Jacob for a meal.
cautions.Korah: In the Bible, Korah is remembered for leading a rebellion against Moses and Aaron.
cautions.Achan: In the Bible, Achan is remembered for stealing from the plunder of Jericho, bringing defeat on Israel.
cautions.Balaam: In the Bible, Balaam is remembered as the prophet hired to curse Israel, who led them into sin.
cautions.Goliath: In the Bible, Goliath is remembered as the Philistine giant who defied Israel and was killed by David.
cautions.Pharaoh: In the Bible, Pharaoh is a title of Egypt's kings, remembered above all for enslaving Israel.
cautions.Sapphira: In the Bible, Sapphira is remembered for lying to the apostles with her husband Ananias.
cautions.Jehoiakim: In the Bible, Jehoiakim is remembered as the king who burned Jeremiah's scroll.
cautions.Abimelech: In the Bible, the best-known Abimelech is Gideon's son, who murdered seventy brothers to rule Shechem.
